rust_summary: any typed play packet to one player's connection (`native_send_play_packet`), as `ServerPlayer.connection.send`.
doc_summary: `native_send_play_packet(player, packet)` sends any `ClientboundPlayPacket` to one player's connection, as `ServerPlayer.connection.send` does: a boss bar, scoreboard or team data, entity data or a mod's own HUD packet. The packet goes as it is, to that player alone; the fixed helpers (action bar, title, sound) keep their own. True when it is queued for their connection, false when they aren't in play yet and on a client. Bundles need "hooks": @API:send_play_packet@.
